en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a metal truss bridge crossing a river, with a horse‑drawn cart and a few pedestrians on the bridge. On the far side are small village houses and, higher on the wooded hill, a large Neo‑Gothic mansion or small castle with a tall spire. Smokestacks from an industrial facility are visible in the background. One gable‑front building by the bridge carries painted commercial signage in German.
